senses.gloss: f. (גרף, cmp. אֶגְרוֹף) [as large as a fist,] little stump or shoot.
units: Kel. XII, 8 ג׳ של זית a vessel made out of a piece of an olive tree; Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 19 he who makes vessels מג׳ של זית R. S. to Kel. l. c. (ed. Zuck. גרפות, גפו, corr. acc.).—Metaph. ג׳ של שקמה block of a sycamore tree, i.e. a man barren of thought, ignorant; barren of merits, worthless. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Leviticus 5">B’ḥuck. 5</cite> Jephtah was as poor in the Law <he>כגְרוֹפוֹ של שקמה</he> (ed. Bub. 7 <he>גרופות של ש׳ היה</he>, note: <cite ref="C01313"><he>גרופית</he></cite>) as a block &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:1:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 25:3">Gen. R. s. 25</cite>, end; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 1:4">Ruth R. s. 1</cite>, opp. <he>ג׳ של זית</he> one rich in merits; a. e.—Pl. <he>גְּרוֹפִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:3">B. Bath. V, 3</cite> if one buys olive trees for felling, <he>מניח שתי ג׳</he> he must leave a stump of two fists’ size (out of which new shoots may rise); <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:7">Tosef. ib. IV, 7</cite> (v. Tos’f. Y. Tob a. l., a.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:14">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, end <he>ג׳ לזתים</he> Ar. (ed. sing.) shoots for future olive plantation.
